description: One checker's run over the corpus: what ran, on what, and under which limits. It is the run.json of a run.

name.description: The name of the run, which is the name of the folder of the checker.

checker.description: The checker, as the checker.json in its folder describes it.

corpus.description: The release that the corpus is of, as v0.5.0, or for a run from a checkout of the repository what git describe says about its commit, as v0.5.0-3-gabc1234.

timeout.description: The seconds that the checker had for one task.

warmup.description: How many tasks each process of the adapter answered before anything was measured.

seed.description: The seed that the order of the tasks was drawn with.

jobs.description: How many processes of the adapter answered side by side. With more than one, the times of the tasks are no more than a hint, since the checks shared the machine.

tasks.description: How many tasks the run has.

platform.description: The system that the run was on.

Checker.description: A checker of the comparison, as the checker.json in its folder describes it.

$schema.description: The schema of this file, for an editor: this one, by a path from a folder under checkers/ or by a URL from anywhere else.

label.description: The checker's name in a report. Folders with the same label are variants of one checker.

variant.description: What tells this folder from another one with the same label, such as the language of the package the checker is used through.

version.description: The version the folder pins, as the report states it.

dialect.description: The dialect the checker reads. Every schema is rewritten to it before the checker is asked.

build.description: The command that builds the adapter. It is run once, in the folder.

run.description: The command that starts the adapter, in the folder.
